name: The Chess Club
description: Regulars at the chess club each swear by a different opening, a favourite tactic, and a prized set. Work out who plays what.
clues: Between Pirc and Arabian, one goes with Nadia and the other with Vera.
Boris goes with Hook if and only if Boden's goes with Mikhail.
Between London and Sicilian, one goes with Nadia and the other with Boden's.
Either Italian goes with Hook or Nadia goes with Hook.
Pirc goes with at least one of Nadia, Arabian, or Damiano's.
Either Mikhail goes with London, or Nadia goes with French — but not both.
